## Activity

During June 2023, Central Eye Clinic recorded 212 captures. This level of activity provides the basis for reviewing the timeliness and quality of the service during the month. Capture records should continue to be completed in accordance with local operating procedures, with any interruptions or equipment concerns noted at the time they occur.

## Image quality

Of the images obtained, 6 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.8 per cent. The result should be monitored as part of routine site oversight, particularly where image quality may be affected by equipment performance or capture technique. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate support process.

## Grading

There were 60 referable results during June 2023. The median grading lag was 2 days. This indicates the typical interval between capture and completion of grading for the reporting period. The site should continue to review grading workflow and address any recurring delays, while maintaining clear records to support ongoing performance monitoring and service improvement.
